auth: No saved account in an isolated HOME. Prompt mode succeeded without user credentials; no user account was logged in.

fields.session_id: result.sessionId (UUID); event envelope uses id/parentId for causal chaining
fields.approval_permission: No standalone permission-request event in non-interactive mode. Denial appears as tool.execution_complete.data.error.code='denied' with message 'Permission denied because no interactive user response was available'. The tool still emits tool.execution_start before the denial.

cross_session_messaging: 无此能力。Copilot CLI has no agent-to-agent messaging between independent sessions; /fleet subagents cannot talk to each other and only the orchestrator coordinates.
evidence: https://github.blog/ai-and-ml/github-copilot/run-multiple-agents-at-once-with-fleet-in-copilot-cli/ (sub-agents cannot talk to each other directly)
